_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on minecraft java/neoforge/egg-neo-forge.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds the neoforge tag and Minecraft Java idle sleep, runs the install in octail-yolks installer_java_21, and has its own install script: NeoForge versions are mapped onto Minecraft versions exactly (the upstream prefix match took 1.21.11's build for 1.21.1 and found nothing for 26.x), the newest stable build wins (the Maven list is not sorted), the installer is checked against the SHA-256 NeoForged's Maven repository publishes, and unix_args.txt is copied next to the server instead of linked.
name: NeoForge
author: glorantv@icloud.com
description: NeoForge Server. NeoForge is a modding API (Application Programming Interface), which makes it easier to create mods, and also make sure mods are compatible with each other. NeoForge is a fork of Minecraft Forge.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# NeoForge installation (Octail): the NeoForge installer from NeoForged's Maven repository, checked against the
# SHA-256 (or, for old files, SHA-1) Maven publishes next to it, then `--installServer`, which downloads the
# Minecraft server and the libraries (the installer checks those against the hashes in its own files).
#
# NeoForge's versions carry the Minecraft version: 21.1.77 is for Minecraft 1.21.1, 21.0.5-beta for 1.21,
# 26.1.0.3 for 26.1 and 26.1.2.3 for 26.1.2; Minecraft 1.20.1's builds are named like Forge's (1.20.1-47.1.106,
# artifact "forge"). "latest" is the Minecraft version of the newest stable NeoForge build; an empty NeoForge
# Version takes the newest stable build for the Minecraft version (its newest beta when it has no stable one).
# A version NeoForge doesn't have fails the install instead of installing another one.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

MAVEN=https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged
VERSION="$(echo "${MC_VERSION:-latest}" | tr -d ' ')"
NEOFORGE="$(echo "${NEOFORGE_VERSION:-}" | tr -d ' ')"

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$1"; }
fetch() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -o "$2" "$1"; }
# The <version> entries of a maven-metadata.xml, one per line (the file isn't sorted).
versions_of() { get "${MAVEN}/$1/maven-metadata.xml" | grep -o '<version>[^<]*</version>' | sed -e 's|<version>||' -e 's|</version>||'; }
# "<NeoForge version> <Minecraft version>" for every line of NeoForge versions that maps onto a Minecraft version.
with_game() {
	awk '{
		if ($0 !~ /^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(-.+)?$/) next
		split($0, p, /[.-]/)
		if ($0 ~ /^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/) g = (p[3] == 0 ? p[1] "." p[2] : p[1] "." p[2] "." p[3])
		else if (p[1] >= 26) next
		else g = (p[2] == 0 ? "1." p[1] : "1." p[1] "." p[2])
		print $0 " " g
	}'
}
# The Minecraft version of one NeoForge version (empty when there is none).
game_of() { with_game | awk '{ print $2 }'; }
# The stable ones (no -alpha or -beta) of a list of versions.
stable_only() { grep -Ev -- '-(alpha|beta)' || true; }
# Is the line $1 in the list $2?
listed() { grep -qxF -- "$1" <<<"$2"; }

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

[[ "${VERSION}" =~ ^[0-9A-Za-z.-]+$ ]] || fail "the Minecraft version (${VERSION}) can only hold letters, digits, dots and dashes"
[[ -z "${NEOFORGE}" || "${NEOFORGE}" =~ ^[0-9A-Za-z.-]+$ ]] || fail "the NeoForge version (${NEOFORGE}) can only hold letters, digits, dots and dashes"

NEO_LIST=$(versions_of neoforge) || fail "can't reach NeoForged's Maven repository (${MAVEN})"
[ -n "${NEO_LIST}" ] || fail "NeoForged's Maven repository lists no NeoForge versions"

if [ -n "${NEOFORGE}" ]; then
	# A pinned build: Minecraft 1.20.1's live in the "forge" artifact.
	if [[ "${NEOFORGE}" == 1.20.1-* ]]; then
		ARTIFACT=forge
		GAME=1.20.1
		LIST=$(versions_of forge) || fail "can't list NeoForge's 1.20.1 builds"
	else
		ARTIFACT=neoforge
		GAME=$(echo "${NEOFORGE}" | game_of)
		LIST="${NEO_LIST}"
	fi
	listed "${NEOFORGE}" "${LIST}" ||
		fail "NeoForge has no version ${NEOFORGE}. The versions are listed at https://projects.neoforged.net/neoforged/neoforge"
	if [ "${VERSION}" != "latest" ] && [ -n "${GAME}" ] && [ "${GAME}" != "${VERSION}" ]; then
		fail "NeoForge ${NEOFORGE} is for Minecraft ${GAME}, not ${VERSION}: change Minecraft Version or NeoForge Version"
	fi
	[ "${VERSION}" != "latest" ] || VERSION="${GAME:-latest}"
else
	if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
		NEWEST=$(echo "${NEO_LIST}" | with_game | awk '{ print $1 }' | stable_only | sort -V | tail -n 1)
		[ -n "${NEWEST}" ] || fail "NeoForge has no stable build"
		VERSION=$(echo "${NEWEST}" | game_of)
		[ -n "${VERSION}" ] || fail "can't tell the Minecraft version of NeoForge ${NEWEST}"
		echo "Latest: NeoForge's newest stable build is for Minecraft ${VERSION}."
	fi
	if [ "${VERSION}" = "1.20.1" ]; then
		ARTIFACT=forge
		CANDIDATES=$(versions_of forge | grep -F '1.20.1-' || true)
	else
		ARTIFACT=neoforge
		CANDIDATES=$(echo "${NEO_LIST}" | with_game | awk -v g="${VERSION}" '$2 == g { print $1 }')
	fi
	[ -n "${CANDIDATES}" ] ||
		fail "NeoForge has no build for Minecraft ${VERSION}. The versions are listed at https://projects.neoforged.net/neoforged/neoforge"
	NEOFORGE=$(echo "${CANDIDATES}" | stable_only | sort -V | tail -n 1)
	if [ -z "${NEOFORGE}" ]; then
		NEOFORGE=$(echo "${CANDIDATES}" | sort -V | tail -n 1)
		echo "Note: Minecraft ${VERSION} has no stable NeoForge build yet; using ${NEOFORGE}."
	fi
fi
echo "Minecraft version: ${VERSION}"
echo "NeoForge version: ${NEOFORGE}"

# The installer and its checksum: SHA-256 when Maven has one, else SHA-1.
URL="${MAVEN}/${ARTIFACT}/${NEOFORGE}/${ARTIFACT}-${NEOFORGE}-installer.jar"
ALGO=""
SUM=""
for a in sha256 sha1; do
	SUM=$(get "${URL}.${a}" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print tolower($1)}') || SUM=""
	if [ -n "${SUM}" ]; then
		ALGO="${a}"
		break
	fi
done
case "${ALGO}" in
sha256) [[ "${SUM}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || fail "NeoForged's Maven repository gave an unreadable SHA-256 for ${NEOFORGE}" ;;
sha1) [[ "${SUM}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || fail "NeoForged's Maven repository gave an unreadable SHA-1 for ${NEOFORGE}" ;;
*) fail "NeoForged's Maven repository has no installer checksum for ${NEOFORGE}" ;;
esac
rm -f installer.jar
fetch "${URL}" installer.jar || fail "the download of the NeoForge ${NEOFORGE} installer failed (${URL})"
GOT=$("${ALGO}sum" installer.jar | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${SUM}" ]; then
	rm -f installer.jar
	fail "${ALGO} mismatch for the NeoForge ${NEOFORGE} installer (expected ${SUM}, got ${GOT})"
fi

# A reinstall starts clean: the old version's libraries and start arguments go first.
rm -rf "libraries/net/neoforged/${ARTIFACT}"
rm -f unix_args.txt

echo "Installing NeoForge ${NEOFORGE} for Minecraft ${VERSION}"
STATUS=0
java -jar installer.jar --installServer || STATUS=$?
rm -f installer.jar installer.jar.log
if [ "${STATUS}" -ne 0 ]; then
	fail "the NeoForge installer failed (see its output above). With unlimited memory (0), the installer may not get enough: give the server a memory limit."
fi

ARGS_FILE="libraries/net/neoforged/${ARTIFACT}/${NEOFORGE}/unix_args.txt"
[ -s "${ARGS_FILE}" ] || fail "the NeoForge installer left no ${ARGS_FILE}: nothing to start"
cp "${ARGS_FILE}" unix_args.txt

echo "NeoForge ${NEOFORGE} for Minecraft ${VERSION} installed (installer ${ALGO} checked); the server starts from unix_args.txt."
echo "Accepting the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) is the server owner's decision: the panel asks on the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.1 or 26.1.2, or latest for the version of NeoForge's newest stable build.

The Startup image must fit it: Java 25 for the newest releases, Java 21 for 1.20.5 to 1.21.x, Java 17 for 1.20.1 to 1.20.4.

variables.name: NeoForge Version
variables.description: The exact NeoForge version, such as 21.1.77, 26.1.2.3 or 1.20.1-47.1.106. Empty: the newest stable build for the Minecraft version. A version NeoForge does not have, or one for another Minecraft version, fails the install.
